title: Chest pain
disclaimer: Follows general first-aid logic. A flight surgeon approves the protocol flown on a mission.

responsive.prompt: Is the person awake and answering?
responsive.help: Tap the shoulder. Ask loudly: are you OK?

breathing_check.help: Open the airway. Watch the chest for 10 seconds.

secure_airway.prompt: Keep the airway open. Stay with them.
secure_airway.help: Restrain the patient so they cannot drift. Call the Crew Medical Officer.

breathing_awake.prompt: Can they breathe and speak in full sentences?
breathing_awake.help: Listen for gasping or very fast breathing.

oxygen_first.prompt: Give oxygen now. Sit them upright.
oxygen_first.help: Fit the oxygen mask. Loosen tight clothing.

vitals.help: Enter what you can. Skip what you cannot measure.

ecg.help: Attach the leads and save the trace. It will be sent with the report.

recent_eva.prompt: Were they outside on EVA in the last 24 hours?
recent_eva.help: Pressure changes after EVA can cause decompression sickness.

dcs_possible.prompt: Possible decompression sickness. Give oxygen and prepare recompression.
dcs_possible.help: Keep them still. Use the suit or airlock for recompression if the Crew Medical Officer agrees.

pain_type.prompt: Is the pain heavy or squeezing, spreading to the arm or jaw?
pain_type.help: Also ask about sweating and nausea.

cardiac.prompt: Possible heart problem. Rest. Give oxygen. Attach the defibrillator pads.
cardiac.help: Give aspirin only if a standing order from the flight surgeon allows it and there is no allergy.

one_sided.prompt: Is it a sudden sharp pain on one side, with shortness of breath?
one_sided.help: More likely after a pressure change or an injury.

pneumothorax.prompt: Possible collapsed lung. Give oxygen. Sit upright. Call the Crew Medical Officer.
pneumothorax.help: The chest decompression kit is for a trained Crew Medical Officer only.

cabin_air.prompt: Do others have headaches, or is the cabin CO₂ alarm on?

co2_exposure.prompt: Possible CO₂ exposure. Move to fresh airflow. Check the scrubber.
co2_exposure.help: Give oxygen if available. Check the rest of the crew.

panic.prompt: Is breathing fast, with tingling fingers, and oxygen level normal?
panic.help: This can be panic or hyperventilation. Treat as a heart problem if unsure.

panic_care.prompt: Coach slow breathing. In for 4, out for 6. Stay with them.
panic_care.help: Re-check vital signs in 5 minutes. If pain continues, treat as a heart problem.

monitor.prompt: Did they stop responding or stop breathing?
monitor.help: Keep watching. Re-check vital signs every 5 minutes.

cpr.help: Push to the beat. Attach the defibrillator as soon as it arrives.

end.help: The log is compressed and queued on the delayed link.
